Retention._comment: The Web host must NOT run the Auth cleanup sweep — that runs on the API host only. This is a defensive default: the Web host does not currently register Auth infrastructure, but if it ever does, this keeps the background cleanup worker disabled here so cleanup never runs from two hosts.

ExternalAuth._comment: Shared HMAC-SHA256 secret with the API — the SAME SigningKey must be configured on both Web and API. Set via user-secrets (dev) or the ExternalAuth__SigningKey environment variable; at least 32 bytes. Left blank intentionally — devs must supply it via user-secrets.

Recaptcha._comment: Google reCAPTCHA v3. Only SiteKey is needed on the Web (client) — SecretKey lives on the API. Same section name is re-used for clarity.

Mapbox._comment: Mapbox GL JS (free tier). Only the public access token (pk.*) belongs here. Leave empty to disable all maps — pages fall back to text-only location info.

Google._comment: Populate from Google Cloud Console. Authorized redirect URI MUST be: https://<web-host>/signin-google (this is the CallbackPath configured on AddGoogle — NOT /auth/external/callback/google, which is the in-app landing route run AFTER the middleware callback).
Google._secretComment: ClientSecret left blank intentionally — supply via user-secrets (dev) or the ExternalProviders__Google__ClientSecret environment variable.

Facebook._comment: Populate from Meta for Developers. Valid OAuth redirect URI MUST be: https://<web-host>/signin-facebook (this is the CallbackPath configured on AddFacebook — NOT /auth/external/callback/facebook, which is the in-app landing route run AFTER the middleware callback).
Facebook._secretComment: AppSecret left blank intentionally — supply via user-secrets (dev) or the ExternalProviders__Facebook__AppSecret environment variable.
